instruction: Research local Thai community app sponsor pricing models comparable to jong-jaroen. Browse: (1) LINE MAN Wongnai merchant pricing page, (2) Robinhood merchant sponsor packages, (3) any Thai local community platform that charges shops for visibility. Goal: validate whether ฿299/฿799/฿1,990 per month is competitive or too high/low for a new community app in rural Rayong province (population ~20k in target zone). Output to wiki/to-b3/GEMINI-RETURN-zone-sponsor-pricing-20260606.md: competitive analysis + recommended price adjustment if any.
